author: JoRo
title: Looking for artist for Steam capsule arts - Lethal Love
content: Looking for an artist to create the Steam capsule arts for my game Lethal Love! I need the full set (header, library, main, small, and related capsules). If you have a strong portfolio in game art / UI / marketing assets and are available, DM me with your rates and previous work. #Steam #IndieGame #GameDev #LookingForArtist #GameArt #SteamCapsule #IndieDev #PixelArt #2DArt
